meaning.value: nonnegative interaction count or source-native quantitative interaction strength before effort standardization
meaning.effort: positive exposure scalar for the row/time-bin scale; use 1 only when value is already effort-standardized or sampling effort is equal by design
meaning.partner_id: primary pollination analysis uses stable pollinator/visitor identity aggregated across plant partners within system × time_bin; adapters may additionally emit a link-identity sensitivity dataset when stable plant and visitor identities are both available

preprocessing.time_bins: use source-native bins exactly; do not merge/split bins after seeing coordinate values
preprocessing.duplicate_rows: sum standardized values within source_study_id × archipelago_id × system_id × time_bin × partner_id
preprocessing.missing_partner_in_observed_time_bin: structural zero after unioning stable partner IDs across admitted bins

coordinate_estimation.breadth_D1: pool standardized values across time for all partner IDs; p_j = partner_j_total / grand_total; D1 = exp(-sum p_j log p_j)
coordinate_estimation.observed_partner_richness: number of partners with positive pooled standardized value
coordinate_estimation.median_time_bin_D1: median Hill D1 across nonempty source-native time bins
coordinate_estimation.eligible_synchrony_partners: partners with positive temporal standard deviation across the admitted time bins
coordinate_estimation.phi: sample variance across time of total standardized interaction strength divided by square of sum of sample SDs of eligible partner time series
coordinate_estimation.mean_pairwise_r: Fisher-z mean of finite Pearson correlations among eligible partner series; correlations clipped to ±(1-1e-12) only for atanh numerical stability
coordinate_estimation.rho_eq: (m * phi - 1) / (m - 1), m = number of eligible synchrony partners; descriptive bridge only

bootstrap.method: resample complete time-bin vectors with replacement within each system and recompute D1 and phi
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th empirical percentiles over finite replicates

source_balancing.system_weight: for S source studies, each study receives total weight 1/S; each system within a study receives equal share of that study weight
source_balancing.weighted_quantile: empirical inverse CDF: smallest sorted value whose cumulative normalized source-balanced weight is >= q
source_balancing.weighted_spearman: compute ordinary midranks of log_D1 and phi across admitted systems, then compute weighted Pearson correlation of those ranks using source-balanced system weights
source_balancing.interior_rectangle: unweighted 25th-75th percentiles of log_D1 and phi; occupancy is the unweighted fraction of systems lying inside both intervals
source_balancing.leave_one_source_out: drop the source study with the largest admitted-system count; ties broken lexicographically by source_study_id; recompute all dispersion/correlation/interior criteria; sample-count minima are not applied to this sensitivity
